context: A uni student gives his teen friend a music recommendation
purpose: Teach: アニメーション/楽曲/魔女/テレビ局/サロン/お笑い/中核/ソング

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 桜、最近ハマってるアニメーションがあってさ、主題歌が本当に良いんだよ。
lines.en: Sakura, there's an animation I've been hooked on lately, and the theme song is really good.
lines.style: Casual upbeat tone of a uni student sharing a discovery with a younger friend.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: へえ、蓮先輩がそんなに推すの珍しいじゃん。何ていう楽曲?
lines.en: Oh, it's rare for you to recommend something so strongly, Ren. What's the song called?
lines.style: Teen girl tone, slightly teasing but curious, casual sentence-final particles.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 「魔女のラジオ」っていうバンドで、深夜番組で流れてたんだよ。
lines.en: It's a band called Majo no Radio, and it was playing on a late-night program.
lines.style: Explanatory casual male speech with relaxed connectives and natural rhythm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 深夜番組?テレビ局ってそういうのちゃんと拾ってくれるんだね。
lines.en: A late-night program? So TV stations actually pick up stuff like that, huh.
lines.style: Curious teen follow-up with light surprise and short, natural clauses.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そう、お笑い番組の後の特集コーナーで、今インディーズの中核なんだって紹介されてた。
lines.en: Yeah, in a feature corner after a comedy program, they were introduced as the core of the indie scene right now.
lines.style: Enthusiastic but informative tone with mid-length sentences explaining context.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 中核って言われると気になるな。今度サロンに行く時に聴いてみよう。
lines.en: Being called the core makes me curious. I'll try listening next time I go to the salon.
lines.style: Light reflective teen speech with casual self-musing and soft enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: おすすめは三曲目のバラード。あと、ラブソングっぽいやつもガチで刺さるから夜聴いてみて。
lines.en: I recommend the third track, a ballad. Also the love-song-ish one really hits hard, so try it at night.
lines.style: Friendly senior advising mode with slangy emphasis, warm and direct.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 了解、帰ったら速攻でプレイリストに入れるね。ありがと先輩!
lines.en: Got it, I'll add it to my playlist right when I get home. Thanks, senpai!
lines.style: Bright closing thanks with teen slang and a cheerful final exclamation.
